item.title: Australia: NSW Launches New AI Governance Framework
item.description: The New South Wales Government has launched a redesigned Artificial Intelligence Assessment Framework to streamline public sector AI oversight, manage risks, and align governance with emerging technologies.

item.title: India: Championing Ethical, Inclusive and Global AI Innovation
item.description: India is positioning itself as a global AI leader through the India AI Impact Summit 2026, combining citizen-driven ethical AI pledges, cutting-edge global innovation challenges and investment in talent and infrastructure.

item.title: Hong Kong: PolyU, UM Launch Joint Robotics and AI Laboratory
item.description: PolyU and UM establish a jointly funded robotics laboratory and dual PhD programme to advance embodied intelligence and autonomous systems research.

item.title: Vietnam: Driving Digital Transformation for Global Competitiveness
item.description: Vietnam’s Resolution 57 is driving local innovation, digital transformation and science-led reforms to strengthen governance, competitiveness and sustainable economic growth nationwide.

item.title: Malaysia Centralises Regulatory Sandbox to Drive Digital Innovation
item.description: Malaysia’s MDEC has integrated the National Regulatory Sandbox into its structure to centralise digital governance, streamline innovation oversight and accelerate AI and emerging technology adoption.

item.title: Australia: Smart Logistics Facility Boosts Victoria Digital Tech Hub Status
item.description: Victoria secures AU$150 million advanced robotics logistics facility, strengthening digital supply chains, workforce capacity and national ICT infrastructure capabilities.

item.title: India Positions AI as Catalyst for Development and Innovation
item.description: India’s AI Impact Summit 2026 in New Delhi highlighted human-centric, globally collaborative AI, promoting innovation, inclusive development, ethical governance and real-world socio-economic applications.

item.title: Hong Kong: HKUST Partner to Advance Blockchain, AI Innovation
item.description: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and Yiyu Network have launched a three-year, HKD 6 million partnership to advance research, innovation and talent development in blockchain and AI.

item.title: Vietnam: Trade Fair Expands Global Technology Partnerships
item.description: Vietnam is using Spring Fair 2026 to expand international partnerships, showcase high-tech capabilities, strengthen regional networks and foster cross-border innovation and collaboration across multiple sectors.

item.title: Singapore: Expanding Community Support for Digital-Age Parents
item.description: Phase 2 of the First Device Campaign has been launched, aiming to strengthen community-based support for parents and help children use technology responsibly and safely in today’s digital age.
